observations: idle四相两靴位置大体固定，细节像素变化；左靴末端较高、右较低。
walk鞋尖相对idle略向中间收，但不是对整个角色做固定统一平移便可获得的变化。
假如实际进入walk57，需允许左端下移约8px、右端上移约14px。实际引擎选取哪一入口帧不由这些静态图证明。
idle→walk保持公共root和源上体/头相对位置，不沿用idle双脚位置。

proxy_comparison_policy: Do not compare source hand-patch center with new fingertips; use homologous visible material regions with uncertainty. Crown-relative differences include head bob and hairstyle, not recovered bone swing. Compare absolute same-root and crown-relative changes separately; no automatic anatomical pass score.
